WidgetStyle.description:
Styling configuration for a specific widget type.

All values reference theme tokens (e.g., 'body', 'primary_color', 'background_color').

font.description: Typography token from theme (h1, h2, h3, body, caption)
font.title: Font

foreground.description: Text color token from theme (primary_color, secondary_color, text_color, etc.)
foreground.title: Foreground

background.description: Background color token from theme (background_color, primary_background, etc.)
background.title: Background

WidgetStyle.title: WidgetStyle

description:
Style configuration that defines how each widget type uses theme tokens.

Each widget type must have an explicit style definition. Any undefined widget
will cause a validation error during layout calculation.

theme_name.description: Name of the theme to apply
theme_name.title: Theme Name

widgets.description: Styling rules for each widget type, referencing theme tokens
widgets.title: Widgets

title: Style
